"""Create a local review summary; no publishing or checkout changes."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog

from check_catalog import application_ids
from export_catalog import clean_text, validate_records
from probe import PROJECT, configured_origin


def build_review(project, candidate, origin):
    folder = (project / "local" / "ays").resolve()
    candidate = candidate.resolve()
    if candidate.parent != folder or not candidate.name.startswith("candidate-") or candidate.suffix != ".json":
        raise ValueError("Choose a candidate in local/ays")
    data = json.loads(candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    if type(data.get("schema_version")) is not int or data["schema_version"] != 1:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported schema")
    if data.get("review_status") != "unreviewed":
        raise ValueError("Unexpected review status")
    if data.get("source") != {"system": "ServiceNow", "origin": origin, "table": "cmdb_ci_business_app"}:
        raise ValueError("Source mismatch")
    expected = application_ids(project)
    if data.get("scope") != {"kind": "configured_app_ids", "expected_ids": sorted(expected)}:
        raise ValueError("Inventory changed; export again")
    records = validate_records(data.get("applications", []), expected)
    names = {}
    for path in sorted((project / "config" / "applications").glob("*.json")):
        app = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        names[app["app_id"]] = clean_text(app.get("name"), 1000)
    groups = {item["support_group"]["sys_id"] for item in records}
    changes = sum(names[item["app_id"]] != item["official_name"] for item in records)
    lines = ["AYS metadata candidate review", "Candidate: " + candidate.name,
             "Fetched UTC: " + clean_text(data.get("fetched_at_utc"), 100),
             f"Applications: {len(records)}", f"Support groups: {len(groups)}",
             f"App names differing from current definitions: {changes}", "",
             "This report does not approve, publish or activate the candidate.",
             "Group email is source metadata; checkout email routing is unchanged.", ""]
    for item in records:
        group = item["support_group"]
        lines.extend([item["app_id"], "  Current name: " + names[item["app_id"]],
                      "  AYS name:     " + item["official_name"],
                      "  Support group: " + group["name"], "  Group email: " + group["email"], ""])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n", len(records), len(groups), changes


def main():
    phase = "choose candidate"
    try:
        folder = PROJECT / "local" / "ays"
        root = tk.Tk()
        root.withdraw()
        try:
            selected = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=root, title="Choose the AYS candidate to review",
                initialdir=str(folder), filetypes=[("Candidate JSON", "candidate-*.json")])
        finally:
            root.destroy()
        if not selected:
            print("REVIEW: CANCELLED")
            return 0
        phase = "candidate validation"
        candidate = Path(selected)
        text, count, groups, changes = build_review(PROJECT, candidate, configured_origin())
        phase = "save review summary"
        destination = candidate.with_suffix(".review.txt")
        # Exclusive creation prevents overwriting an earlier review.
        with destination.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(text)
        print("APPS REVIEWED:", count)
        print("SUPPORT GROUPS:", groups)
        print("NAME DIFFERENCES:", changes)
        print("REVIEW: READY; open the .review.txt file in local/ays")
        return 0
    except FileExistsError:
        print("REVIEW: Already exists; open the .review.txt file in local/ays")
        return 0
    except Exception:
        print("REVIEW: STOPPED; phase=" + phase)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
